status: CONFIG ONLY. NOT_EXECUTED: no regression run has been made under this config.
purpose: PLAN.md decision rule 4 (general skills hold): every trained arm must stay within 2 points of the stock Qwen3.5-4B on each benchmark's primary metric. This file fixes the datasets, revisions, slices, metrics and decoding before any training batch.

rule_4.applies_to: primary_metric of each benchmark, trained arm minus stock 4B, same host, same session, same serving path
rule_4.comparison: point estimates as preregistered in PLAN.md; per-item paired outcomes are also saved so the noise can be reported beside each delta

serving.model_trained: the arm's LoRA merged into the same base checkpoint, converted and quantized to Q4_K_M by PR #95's merge-to-GGUF path, so stock and trained differ only in weights

bfcl.why_this_slice: non-live single-turn AST categories plus irrelevance: they need no executable APIs or network, and irrelevance catches a tuned model that calls tools when none apply (the over-calling failure W1 could teach)

harness.checker: AST checker (ast_checker) and irrelevance rule from the package; generation through native tool calling on llama-server with the dataset's function docs as tools
harness.runner: to be written in Phase 3 and preregistered with its hash before the first regression run

mmlu_pro.slice: 1,400 test questions: 100 per category x 14 categories, ids in mmlu_pro_subset.json (rule inside the file)

harness.task: mmlu_pro (5-shot chain of thought from the validation split, answer extracted by the task's regex)
harness.subset: the task restricted to the listed question_ids

also_reported: share of answers the regex could not extract

general_data_mix: PLAN.md mixes about 25% general data into training. None of these regression items, and nothing from these dataset repositories, may be in that mix; the Phase 3 data builder must check it.
records: per-item outputs stay private (outside Git); only summaries with per-item pass vectors' sha256 are committed
cost_note: Not in PLAN.md's 36 GPU-hour estimate as a separate line. Rough count: 3,181 items per model; at the round-2 4B decode rate about 0.5-1 GPU-hour per model on a T4, so about 3-6 hours for base plus five arms. To be measured on the first run.
